headline: Executive order sets rules for how the federal government works to recover Americans taken hostage.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with how the federal government handles hostage recovery. Based on its title, it sets out how agencies organize and carry out efforts to get hostages released. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Americans held hostage and their families
who_it_affects.how: The order shapes how the government works on efforts to bring hostages home.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies involved in hostage cases
who_it_affects.how: The order directs how these agencies organize and carry out hostage recovery work.
